title: Karnataka Jyothi Sanjeevini Scheme (JSS) Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: Health benefit scheme for eligible Karnataka government employees and their dependants under the state employee health framework.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligible Karnataka state government employees and covered dependants according to current service rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Karnataka Jyothi Sanjeevini Scheme (JSS).

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
